status: Human explanation and clarification only; no literal page correction authorized by this record
raw_statement: in 0143, the C1-C2-C3 parts form a group of internally connected gates; normally written with C1 and C2 as AND gates, and C3 as an OR gate. The DT011 use of the group switches that AND and OR functions, and adds inversion on the C1 and C2 inputs.
clarification_prompt: Did you mean DT001 is the case that switches the C1/C2 AND and C3 OR functions? DT001 C3 reads A, while DT011 C3 reads OR.
selection_note: The parenthesized recommended marker is the UI option label. The selected answer confirms DT001 as the switched case.
